kieran moriarty nora finnegan holy god, we praise thy name lord of all, we bow before thee. all on earth thy sceptre own, all in heaven above adore thee. endless is thy vast domain, everlasting is thy reign. hark, with loud and pealing hymn thee the angel choirs above are praising; cherubim and seraphim, one unceasing chorus raising, ever sing with sweet accord, holy, holy, holy, lord. hail, queen of heaven, the ocean star, guide of the wanderer here below, thrown on life's surge, we claim thy care, save us from peril and from woe. mother of christ, o star of the sea pray for the wanderer, pray for me. ogentle, chaste, and spotless maid, we sinners make our prayers through thee; remind thy son that he has paid the price of our iniquity. virgin most pure, ostar of the sea, pray for the
